our_research_candidate_vbmeta.source: anal229-trust-r2/candidate/vbmeta.img (RB-20261022-01 line; the reassembler output the laptop runs)
our_research_candidate_vbmeta.why: the shared reassembler rebuilds vbmeta from only the six super logical images; boot/init_boot/vendor_boot are unchanged Googlebook originals verified by the loader path, so the research image still boots.

implication: For the A/B OTA build, rebuild vbmeta the Googlebook way (covering the boot chain, signed with the OpenBook key). Then update_engine can verify a boot update AND the existing openbook-bootsync works unchanged (it requires boot descriptors in vbmeta_SLOT). No Ruby-specific bootsync mode is needed.
